# Continuation Final Plan — One Owner, One River, One Verified Product

The Awtsmoos recreates every moment from nothing; Awtsmoos.com must recreate certainty from direct proof.
The continuation path is evidence-led: test inherited behavior, discover active ownership, rewrite only proven defects, then verify the full user journey.

## Phase A — Inherited behavior

- Run `AutoScrollRoot.test.mjs` and `AutoScrollDown.test.mjs` unchanged first.
- Read semantic pace, preferences, root resolver, document adapter, and movement controller as one execution graph.
- If a test fails, prove whether production or test is stale before rewriting a whole file.

## Phase B — Active ownership map

- Read `_awtsmoos.post.html`, `main.css`, direct-loaded reader styles, and recursive descendants.
- Map active conflicts for floating controls, auto-scroll, typography settings, scroll root, sidebar, overlays, community, menus, sheets, and z-index.
- Read Heichel template/bootstrap/style closure and social `index.css`/bootstrap closure.
- Inventory user-facing route entrypoints under `heichelos`.

## Phase C — Runtime behavior trace

- Community: panel -> fetching -> tree -> `/comment-tree` -> server route -> data/auth response.
- Main Menu: trigger -> registry -> overlay/sheet -> child views -> back navigation.
- Scribe's Lens: trigger -> settings state -> controls -> persistence/reset.
- Heichel: template -> bootstrap -> cards/series/posts/actions/menu/dialogs/social surfaces.
- Social: root -> navigation/feed/profile/composer/notifications/interactions/search/discovery/comments.

## Phase D — Whole-file repairs only

For every proven defect: read the full current owner; preserve working public selectors/exports/contracts; rewrite the whole file; split oversized responsibility into focused modules; use tabs, B"H / Boruch Hashem / Blessed is He headers, and meaningful Awtsmoos-oriented documentation; introduce neither `!important` nor selector escalation.

## Phase E — Browser proof

- Start the real server from discovered package scripts.
- Verify 390x844, 430x932, 768x1024, and 1440x900.
- Measure auto-scroll start, pause, resume, stop, and pace change on the owning root.
- Verify Main Menu and all registered child views.
- Verify Scribe's Lens controls, internal scroll, focus, safe area, and reduced motion.
- Verify community success, truthful failure, retry recovery, and empty-state distinction.
- Sweep Heichel and social routes with console/network evidence.

## Phase F — Completion audit

- Run discovered tests and syntax checks.
- Re-scan active CSS closure for `!important` and duplicate ownership.
- `wc -l` every touched source file.
- Re-read every touched file in full.
- Compare the original 0240 plan to actual implementation and this continuation delta.
- Write `03-implementation-readback.md`, `04-browser-verification.md`, and `05-final-delta-and-completion-gate.md` into the original 0240 folder without overwriting history.

## Completion gate

No success claim until all sixteen user-stated gates have evidence. A genuine external blocker must identify the exact failed capability and preserve all completed surrounding proof; otherwise REMAINING_WORK must become empty.

## NEXT_ACTION

Execute Phase A, then immediately continue into Phase B even if every auto-scroll unit test is green.
